title: REQ · Tick ignores future rounds and rounds in other statuses and keeps closing after an open failure
summary: Non-due and non-matching rounds are skipped; errors are joined and the pass continues
description: Context: Tick skips rounds not matching either case and collects errors in errs, returning errors.Join(errs...). Desired behavior: failure to open one round never prevents closing another. Expected result: Tick returns an error wrapping the open error while Close still runs. Why: a stuck round must not block expiry of others.
acceptance_criteria: Given future SCHEDULED, future OPEN and COMPLETED rounds, when Tick runs before the boundary, then no Controller call is made.
Given Open returns an error for one round, when Tick runs, then Close is still called for an expired OPEN round.
Given Open returns an error, when Tick returns, then errors.Is(err, openErr) is true.

in_scope: Skip logic and error aggregation in Tick

technical_constraints: Do not return early from the per-round loop on a Controller error
definition_of_done: Skip and continue-on-error behavior matches the acceptance criteria
